newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Broward County, Fla.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Broward County, Fla.

text.p: $6,610,000 Revenue Anticipation Renewal Notes, Series 1997A $8,900,000 Revenue Anticipation Renewal Notes, Series 1997B
Sealed bids will be received by The School District of Broward County, Florida (the '
at its offices at 600 Southeast Third Avenue, 10th Floor, Fort Lauderdale, Florida 33301 for the purchase of

$40,740,000 in aggregate principal amount of The School District of Broward County, Florida Revenue Anticipation Renewal Notes, Series 1997A, Revenue Anticipation Renewal Notes, Series 1997B, and Revenue Anticipation Notes, Series 1997C (collectively, the Notes'') dated April 30, 1997. The District will accept the facsimile transmission of a manually signed Official Bid Form at the risk of the bidder. The Facsimile transmission shall be submitted to Mr. George L. Latimer, Deputy Superintendent - Financial Management & Support Services, through (954) 760-7366, (954) 760-7458 or (954) 760-7321.

The Notes will be issued in fully-registered, book-entry- only form through a program qualified with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, as depository, in the denomination of $5,000 each or integral multiples thereof, and will pay interest only upon their maturity on April 22, 1998.

The Notes will be payable from and secured by the ad valorem tax payments collected for capital outlay purposes of the District during its fiscal year ending June 30, 1998. The Notes are not subject to redemption prior to their stated date of maturity.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Official Notice of Note Sale, the Official Bid Form and the Form of Opinion of Ruden, McClosky, Smith, Schuster & Russell, P.A., Fort Lauderdale, Florida and the Law Offices of Steve E. Bullock, Miami, Florida, Co-Bond Counsel, may be obtained after Tuesday April 15, 1997 from Public Financial
Management, Inc., 201 South Orange Avenue, Suite 720, Orlando, Florida 32801 (407) 648-2208 or Fidelity Financial Services, L.C., 2750 North 29th Avenue, Suite 209,
Advisors to the District. THIS SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE SUPERSEDES THE SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE PUBLISHED ON MARCH 25, 1997.
The School District of Broward County, Florida
